artworks.title: Jean-Pierre Sarrazin
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has long, wavy hair that falls just below his shoulders. His facial features include a mustache and a closed-lip smile, with prominent eyes and a smooth complexion. He is wearing a wide-collared garment with a detailed tie or brooch at the neck, and a draped fabric over his shoulders. The background consists of a detailed engraved oval frame with inscriptions, and below the portrait, there is a panel with text, all set against a lined backdrop.

artworks.title: Charles-Paris d'Orléans-Longueville, Comte de Saint-Pol
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a portrait, positioned in a three-quarter view facing right with long, wavy hair and a gentle facial expression. They wear an ornate robe with a white collar and a chain with a cross pendant around their neck. The background includes an oval frame with text along the inner border, and below the portrait is a crest with three fleur-de-lis and a crown. The artwork is detailed and engraved.

artworks.title: Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a half-length view. He is seated facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a pointed mustache, a short goatee, medium-length hair combed back, and is dressed in formal attire including a garment with a wide, white collar. He wears a pendant with a star emblem around his neck. The portrait is framed by an ornate border of foliage, and the background is dark, contrasting with the lighter tones of his attire and the frame.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Retz
artworks.description: It is a portrait of a man facing slightly left. He has a slightly rounded face, pronounced eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a small mustache. He has wavy, mid-length hair and is wearing a clerical robe with an embellished pattern and high collar. Around his neck is a chain with a large cross pendant. The background is a simple, lightly patterned surface.

artworks.title: Claude Regnauldin
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has a slender face with a high forehead and defined cheekbones, along with a pointy beard and mustache that are mostly gray. His wavy hair matches his facial hair, extending to his collar. He is wearing an ecclesiastical outfit with a buttoned vest under a robe and a white clerical collar. He also wears a cap typical of clerical attire. The portrait is set within an oval frame with a crest at the base featuring a tree emblem. The background inside the oval is textured, while the outer area contains Latin inscriptions encircling the frame.

artworks.title: Pierre Poncet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with a bust view. He is facing the viewer with his body slightly angled to the right. The man has a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and a subtle smile. He has medium-length wavy hair that falls to his shoulders. He is wearing a dark robe with an intricately detailed buttoned vest, a wide white collar, and no visible jewelry. The background is plain with ornate framing elements, including a coat of arms and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Pierre Poncet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing slightly to his right, looking at the viewer. He has distinct facial features including a prominent nose and high cheekbones, wavy shoulder-length hair, and is dressed in traditional academic or clerical attire. The portrait is encased within an oval frame with Latin text around it and a coat of arms below featuring a fleur-de-lis and star. The background outside the oval frame is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Simon Arnauld, Le Marquis de Pomponne
artworks.description: The portrait depicts the upper body of a person, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is looking directly at the viewer with distinct facial features including a long, narrow nose, prominent lips, and slightly arched eyebrows. The subject's hair is long and curly, falling around the face and shoulders in voluminous waves. He is wearing elaborate clothing with a richly patterned fabric and a high lace collar. The background of the image is plain with an oval frame encircling the portrait, with inscribed text in Latin.

artworks.title: Louis-Marie, Queen of Poland
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Justus van Verus
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned facing slightly to the right, with her gaze directed towards the viewer. Her facial features include a rounded face, soft expression, and a small closed smile, with curly and voluminous hair styled elegantly, parted in the middle and decorated with a simple pearl earring dangling from her visible ear. She is adorned in a luxurious garment that drapes around her shoulders, featuring bows and layers that suggest opulence and sophistication. A single strand pearl necklace accentuates her neckline. The background is a finely detailed oval frame surrounding the portrait, set against a darker shaded area, featuring inscriptions within the inner circular border and additional text below.

artworks.title: Hardouin de Perefixe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper torso, including his head and shoulders. The man is facing slightly to his right with his facial features visible. He has a high forehead, a well-defined nose, light facial hair framing his face, and medium-length hair curling at the ends. He is wearing a high-collared coat or robe with a large collar, fastened at the neck with a decorative bow. Attached to the collar is a star-shaped medallion. The background features a pattern of three-dimensional stars, and the entire image is encased in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Hardouin de Perefixe
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust portrait of a person facing slightly left within an oval frame. The person has a distinguished and aged appearance with receding hair, wavy grey hair, a narrow mustache, and goatee. He wears a clerical robe with a white collar, a dark garment, and a cross-shaped medallion around his neck. The background is plain, and the oval frame has an inscription and decorative stars around the edge.

artworks.title: Hardouin de Perefixe
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man from the upper half of his body, slightly turned to his right. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and a high forehead. His hair is of medium length, wavy, and graying. He is wearing a clerical collar and has a decorative badge pinned to his garment in the shape of a Maltese cross. The background is simple, with the man framed within an oval border surrounded by horizontal lines. Below the oval, there is a coat of arms and French script, indicating the name "Hardouin de Péréfixe Archevêque de Paris," along with additional decorative motifs.

artworks.title: Hardouin de Perefixe
artworks.description: This is an image of the upper half of a man's body. He is seated and facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a straight mustache. His shoulder-length, wavy hair appears light in color. He is dressed in attire resembling that of a historical figure, with a garment featuring a wide, white collar and a decorative emblem around his neck. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame, with a coat of arms below it. The background features finely ruled lines.

artworks.title: Pierre Payen
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body within an ornate oval frame. He faces slightly left, with eye contact. The man has a strong jawline, prominent nose, small moustache, and shoulder-length, curly, tousled hair. He wears a dark, formal garment with a wide, white collar and a tassel. The background has textured, finely hatched lines. There is an inscription within the oval frame, and a decorative crest at the bottom. The drawing is monochromatic with detailed shading.

artworks.title: Philippe, Duc d'Orléans
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a man's upper body, from the shoulders up. The man is facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. He has long curly hair, reaching his shoulders. His facial features include a pointed chin, full lips, and wide, slightly arched eyebrows. He is wearing detailed attire with a lace cravat and a garment featuring a fleur-de-lis pattern. The clothing has intricate embellishments. There are no visible objects or jewelry on him. The background features an ornate border with text and fleur-de-lis motifs.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste van Steenberghen
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated in a slightly turned position, with their head facing forward in a three-quarters view. The individual has a full face, mustache, and curly hair flowing to the shoulders. They wear a dark robe with a large, light-colored collar. The subject is surrounded by an oval frame with decorative elements and inscriptions. The background consists of a uniform pattern enhancing the focus on the individual within the ornate frame.

artworks.title: Nicholas Potier de Novion
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body portrait of a man positioned slightly angled to the viewer, looking directly forward. He has long, wavy hair that falls to his shoulders and a mustache and goatee that complement his pointed facial features. The man is wearing a fur-trimmed garment and a cloak that is wrapped around his shoulders and neck. He is adorned with a cross-shaped medal pinned over his sheer cloak. The portrait is surrounded by an intricately carved oval frame with ribbons woven through it and set against a simple, textured background. Below the frame's base sits a decorative element displaying a crest with ornate detailing. The entire image appears to be rendered in a detailed, grayscale technique, likely an engraving.

artworks.title: Nicholas Potier de Novion
artworks.description: The image is a portrait depicting a person's head and upper chest. The person is shown in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the left and looking directly at the viewer. They have a mustache, a goatee, and long wavy hair falling to the shoulders. The person is wearing a cloak or robe with an ornate medallion hanging from the neckpiece resembling an eight-pointed star or cross. The background shows an intricately detailed, octagonal frame with floral or leaf patterns. The portrait is mounted above a decorative ledge with a coat of arms featuring a shield and botanical motifs.

artworks.title: Nicholas Potier de Novion
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man with his upper body visible. He is facing forward with his head turned slightly to the right. The man has distinct facial features, including a high forehead and a goatee. His hair is long, wavy, and reaches past his shoulders. He is wearing a richly textured garment with a fur collar and striped sleeves. An oval frame encloses the portrait within an ornamental border featuring a coat of arms and decorative scrolls. The background consists of intricate line work.

artworks.title: Ferdinand de Neufville
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait engraving of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to his right with his head turned toward the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, including a long, slightly upturned nose, a subtle smile, and wrinkles around his eyes. He has shoulder-length, wavy hair that is neatly combed back. The man is wearing formal ecclesiastical clothing, with a clerical collar visible above a dark robe. He is wearing a large cross around his neck on a chain. The portrait is framed by an ornate oval frame with Latin text surrounding the image. The lower centerpiece of the frame features a coat of arms with a shield and a ceremonial hat. The background of the frame consists of fine engraved lines.

artworks.title: Ferdinand de Neufville
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the chest up. He is positioned in a three-quarter view, turning slightly to his right with a calm expression. His facial features include a prominent nose, lightly arched eyebrows, and lips forming a gentle smile. His hair is medium length, slightly wavy, falling around his ears. He wears a collar with a buttoned cassock and a cross-shaped pendant on a chain around his neck. The background shows a decorative oval frame with Latin text engraved around the inner edge and an ornate heraldic emblem below the portrait. The overall background consists of precise lines and shading typical of detailed engravings.

artworks.title: Ferdinand de Neufville

artworks.title: Ferdinand de Neufville
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He is positioned in a slight three-quarter angle, turning slightly to his left while gazing directly forward. The man has a long, narrow face with a high forehead, a small mustache, and wavy hair that reaches just past his ears. He is wearing a clerical robe with a high, pointed white collar and a chain with a cross pendant around his neck. The background features an elaborate frame with decorative leaf motifs surrounding the portrait and an ornate pedestal below with a coat of arms, shield, and floral designs.

artworks.title: Francois de Nesmond
artworks.description: This is a portrait engraving depicting a man in a three-quarter profile position, facing slightly to his right. His facial features show a composed expression, a prominent nose, and slightly arched eyebrows. He has short, dark, wavy hair and is dressed in clerical clothing with a high collar and a cassock. He wears a large cross on a chain around his neck. The portrait is set within an oval frame with inscriptions, above a coat of arms with intricate designs. The background consists of finely etched lines for texture.
